title: ICE Agent Thomas Bailey Arrested for Breaking Into Ex-Girlfriend's Louisiana Apartment
detail: The St. Tammany Parish Sheriff's Office announced Friday, August 21, 2026 the arrest of Thomas Bailey, 58, an ICE agent assigned to the agency's Oakdale, Louisiana office, on a charge of unauthorized entry of an inhabited dwelling after he allegedly entered his ex-girlfriend's Covington apartment without permission while she was not home. Bailey was booked into the St. Tammany Parish Correctional Center; the charge carries up to six years in prison and a maximum $1,000 fine if he is convicted. The case is being handled as a local criminal matter rather than an internal ICE disciplinary action, and adds to a running tally of off-duty misconduct allegations against ICE personnel during the agency's second-term hiring surge.
